name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: A dropzone-style file upload area with type presets for document, image, video, audio, and attachment uploads.

docs.lead: A styled dropzone area for file uploads with built-in presets for document, image, video, audio, and attachment types. Each preset includes a unique illustration, title, description, and button text for consistent usage across the platform.

examples.title: Document Upload
examples.description: Preset for uploading documents (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ZIP).

examples.title: Video Upload
examples.description: Preset for uploading videos (MP4, AVI, MOV).

examples.title: Audio Upload
examples.description: Preset for uploading audio files (MP3, WAV).

examples.title: Custom Overrides
examples.description: Override the preset title, description, or button text.
examples.code:
<FileUpload.Dropzone
  type="image"
  title="Upload your banner image"
  description="Recommended size: 1200 × 675 px"
  buttonText="Choose Image"
  inputProps={{ accept: 'image/*' }}
/>

examples.title: Dragging
examples.description: Visual feedback when a file is dragged over the dropzone.
examples.code:
<FileUpload.Root dragging>
  <FileUpload.Content>
    <FileUpload.Title>Drop your file here</FileUpload.Title>
    <FileUpload.Description>Release to start the upload.</FileUpload.Description>
  </FileUpload.Content>
  <FileUpload.Button>Choose file</FileUpload.Button>
</FileUpload.Root>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Blocks interaction (the hidden file input is disabled so the file picker cannot open). The title, description, and button shift to muted disabled colors while the icon stays as-is — the dropzone is not uniformly dimmed.

examples.title: Disabled (hand-composed)
examples.description: `disabled` on Root is passed down through context, so Button, Icon, Title, and Description mute themselves without being told individually. Pass `disabled` on a slot to override what it inherits — an explicit value always wins, so `disabled={false}` keeps that one slot at full strength.
examples.code:
<FileUpload.Root disabled>
  <FileUpload.Icon as={RiImageLine} />
  <FileUpload.Content>
    <FileUpload.Title>Upload your banner image</FileUpload.Title>
    <FileUpload.Description>Recommended size: 1200 × 675 px</FileUpload.Description>
  </FileUpload.Content>
  <FileUpload.Button>Choose file</FileUpload.Button>
</FileUpload.Root>

api.name: FileUpload.Dropzone
api.description: A convenience preset component that renders the full dropzone based on file type.

props.name: type
props.description: The upload type preset. Determines the icon, title, description, and button text.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: Props passed to the hidden file input (e.g., accept, multiple).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the dropzone: mutes the title/description/button to disabled colors (icon unchanged), removes the pointer cursor and hover state, blocks click/drag interaction, and disables the hidden file input.

api.name: FileUpload.Root
api.description: The dropzone container for custom compositions. Renders as a <label> by default.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge props onto a child element instead of rendering a <label>.

props.name: dragging
props.description: When true, applies a highlighted border and background to indicate drag-over state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks click/drag interaction via pointer-events, removes the pointer cursor and hover state, and puts the dropzone on the weak background. Also provided through context: Button, Icon, Title, and Description mute themselves from it, so a hand-composed dropzone dims without threading `disabled` to every slot. An explicit `disabled` on a slot wins over the inherited value.

api.name: FileUpload.Content
api.description: Wrapper for the title and description with consistent vertical spacing.

api.name: FileUpload.Title
api.description: The main heading text inside the dropzone.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Mutes the title to the disabled color. Inherited from a disabled Root when omitted; set it here to override that.

api.name: FileUpload.Description
api.description: Secondary description text (e.g., accepted formats, size limits).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Mutes the description to the disabled color. Inherited from a disabled Root when omitted; set it here to override that.

api.name: FileUpload.Button
api.description: A visual button inside the dropzone.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Mutes the button label to the disabled color. Inherited from a disabled Root when omitted; set it here to override that.

api.name: FileUpload.Icon
api.description: A polymorphic icon slot for custom compositions.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Mutes the icon to the disabled color. Inherited from a disabled Root when omitted; set it here to override that. The Dropzone presets render their own illustration rather than this slot, so their icon keeps its color when disabled.
